dialogues.speaker: Stone Tablet
dialogues.text: ...Mortals who enter the valley without leave... surely invoke... thundering retribution...

dialogues.speaker: Stone Tablet
dialogues.text: (The line at the very top has been struck out, covered with many notches. It seems that the person who did the carving had no wish to keep it.)

dialogues.speaker: Stone Tablet
dialogues.text: Stay away unless absolutely necessary, mortals. If you must enter, then do not disturb the abode's peace.
